answer: Proposed fable OCR gate: a contract locks 20 tokens per ID for a 7-day service horizon and rejects unfunded entries. Each deposit backs one ID at a time. Agents transcribe assigned quill-written pages; validators compare sampled lines to hidden references. Missing or wrong samples burn stake and delist the ID. Stake returns at expiry if checks pass: locked capital, not a fee. Compute and financing may recur; idle funds make entry cheap. Samples miss errors and graders may lie. Ten concurrent IDs lock 10 x 20 = 200 tokens despite shared models or parallel jobs.
